objectives.label: Ask permission to use a computer
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask permission with 'Ali lahko ___?' + a present-tense verb.

objectives.label: Ask whether to reserve
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask a yes/no follow-up with 'Ali moram rezervirati?'

objectives.label: Ask about WiFi
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether they also have WiFi with 'Ali imate tudi ___?'

objectives.label: Ask for the password
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for the password with 'Kakšno je geslo?'

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Good day! Go ahead, tell me.
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan! Kar povejte.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali lahko uporabljam računalnik?
c1a.en: Hello. May I use a computer?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi uporabljal računalnik.
c1b.en: Hello. I'd like to use a computer.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Seveda. Računalniki so v prvem nadstropju.
n2.en: Of course. The computers are on the first floor.
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Seveda. Računalniki so v prvem nadstropju.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Do I have to reserve one?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Ne. Rezervacija ni potrebna. Če je kakšen prost, ga lahko uporabite.
n3.en: No. No reservation needed. If one is free, you can use it.
n3.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ne. Rezervacija ni potrebna. Če je kakšen prost, ga lahko uporabite.

c3.speaker: client
c3.sl: V redu, hvala. Ali imate tudi WiFi?
c3.en: Alright, thanks. Do you also have WiFi?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Da, seveda.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Geslo je na nalepki pri vhodu.
n5.en: The password is on a sticker by the entrance.
n5.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Geslo je na nalepki pri vhodu.
